description: This file defines the MedicalImagingClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the AWS Health Imaging service, including operations such as copying image sets, creating datastores, deleting resources, retrieving images, and managing metadata.

classes.name: MedicalImagingClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Health Imaging service, providing methods for various imaging operations.

methods.name: copyImageSet
methods.description: Copies an image set within the AWS Health Imaging service.

methods.name: createDatastore
methods.description: Creates a new datastore for storing images.

methods.name: getDICOMImportJob
methods.description: Retrieves information about a DICOM import job.

methods.name: getImageSetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an image set.

methods.name: listImageSetVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of an image set.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: searchImageSets
methods.description: Searches for image sets based on criteria.

methods.name: startDICOMImportJob
methods.description: Starts a new DICOM import job.

methods.name: updateImageSetMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata of an image set.
